description: Discover calendars: without arguments, all 250 countries and 30 markets; with a country code, its legal weekend, subdivision codes, holiday categories, languages, year range and public sources. Free. Example: country 'US'. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = fixed-date calendar; medium = a lunar/moon-sighted or projected holiday is involved, or the caller overrode the weekend), estimated_items[] naming each projected date, sources[] (public references behind the calendar), data_version and warnings[].

country.description: Country code or market MIC for details (weekend, subdivisions, categories, languages, sources). Omit to list all 250 countries and 30 markets.
country.title: Country
